text:
tori: follow-up from the postmortem — KV-cache OOMs last night. Capturing owners + quick mitigations.
neil: ack. I'll own a minimal repro + allocation flamegraph. ETA Tue EOD.
anya: I'll take GC knobs and slab-audit. Will bench on staging.
neil: repro command (local):
```
$ ./bin/kv-stress --shards 2 --concurrency 250 --batch 100 --duration 60s --url http://localhost:8080/prefetch
```
neil: prelim profile shows repeated ~32MB pinned buffers from ShardCache::pin retained after response finish. Adding pin/unpin tracing.
tori: short-term plan: 1) soft cap pinned entries per-shard -> 40 behind flag; 2) emergency_evict flag that evicts oldest pinned entries under memory pressure; 3) schedule mem-stress QA on canary.
anya: GC tuning: lower slab-grow-threshold 0.8->0.65 and run a young-gen trim every 3k requests. I will propose numbers in PR.
ops-bot: scheduled job mem-canary-197777 for Mon 23:30 UTC against canary (4 shards).
neil: I'll add a CI regression that fails on pinned growth > 80MB over 5m.
tori: recurring pattern note: fragmentation spikes after compaction windows. We should add kv.fragmentation_pct to dashboards and alert on >25% for 10m.
anya: agreed. I'll add dashboard panel + alert.
neil: PRs: #5040 (soft-cap + flag), #5042 (CI regression), anya will post GC PR.
tori: owners recap: neil (profiling + CI), anya (GC + dashboards), tori (runbook + exec summary). Please update thread with PR links and QA results. Reconvene next Wed to review outcomes.
